comment: Independent C-first learned SPE_JUMPING witness: wish/read a blessed jumping book, then #cast and #jump without physical jumping. Covers docast and apply.c jump spell fallback into the same canonical spell caller; in-place targets exercise ECMD_OK feedback and outer cast time. C-only correction: the first cast leaves insufficient energy for the fallback, so forty ordinary rest turns recharge before #jump. C-only correction: two leading spaces acknowledge the full-moon startup message before issuing #levelchange; the earlier prefix was consumed at startup. C-only correction: acknowledge each experience-level message before wishing/reading; unused acknowledgment spaces are ordinary commands.
